title: Fix Black-Hole & Store-to-Store Flows
scenario: A valid DFD forbids "black holes" (processes with no output), "miracles" (processes with no input), and direct Store-to-Store transfers. In this broken utility billing diagram, "1.0 Import Usage" has no output, "D1 Raw Usage" writes straight to "D2 Invoices", and "2.0 Generate Invoice" has no input.
goal: Remove the illegal store-to-store edge and wire the pipeline so every process has both inputs and outputs while persisting usage and invoices properly.
learningObjective: Eliminate DFD black holes, miracles, and direct Store-to-Store transfers by routing through processes.
hints: Data cannot flow directly from D1 Raw Usage to D2 Invoices without a process.
1.0 Import Usage should write to D1 Raw Usage, and 2.0 Generate Invoice should read from D1 Raw Usage and write to D2 Invoices.

Keep Meter -> 1.0 Import Usage and 2.0 Generate Invoice -> Customer, delete D1 Raw Usage -> D2 Invoices, and add 1.0 Import Usage -> D1 Raw Usage, D1 Raw Usage -> 2.0 Generate Invoice, and 2.0 Generate Invoice -> D2 Invoices.
solutionExplanation: Removing the illegal Store-to-Store flow and connecting 1.0 Import Usage -> D1 Raw Usage -> 2.0 Generate Invoice -> D2 Invoices resolves the black hole, miracle, and store-to-store errors.

solutions.description: Balanced billing pipeline with no black holes, miracles, or store-to-store edges

edges.description: Import saves readings to D1 Raw Usage
Generate Invoice reads D1 Raw Usage
Generate Invoice stores invoice in D2 Invoices
Generate Invoice sends bill to Customer
